Introduction.
This document explains the test steps that must be carried out annually. The first draft was prepared by Eng. Mahmoud Ahmed Mahmoud at New Assiut Power Station "El-Walidia" 2x300 MW, Upper Egypt Electricity Production Company, and the test was carried out on 8 May 2005 by Eng. Ali Hussein Farrag and Eng. Mahmoud Faisal Mohamed.
Safety Precautions.
Issue an approved work permit from the competent authority, and the test crew must carry an industrial safety category card.
Fence the work area and place the necessary warning signs.
Follow the occupational safety and health instructions for the safety of personnel and equipment.
The unit is shut down and out of service, and the generator is out of service.
Make sure the protection device to be tested is as stated on the name plate.
Tools and Equipment Used.
2 current and voltage injection sets model PHU-100.
2 current and voltage injection sets model PHU-100.
2 standard V-A AC current measuring instruments, model YOKOGAWA.
Test Leads.
2 transformers 400/200 V, 1 kVA, single phase.
1 test plug model XRT-1.
1 three-phase switch.
Avometer Fluky 87.
1 Digital Phase Meter (KDK DPF-30N).
Contact point cleaning tools (spray CROWN-8276).
Maintenance Steps to be Carried Out.
Disconnect terminals T5 44, 46 inside cell P1PRP to prevent disabling the generator cooling water system. | 1.
Remove the front cover of the relay, phase R. | 2.
Withdraw the relay connection comb, phase R. | 3.
Clean the contact points using (Spray CROWN-8276). | 4.
Clean the relay from dust using the air blower, taking care not to direct the air at the springs. | 5.
Connect the following red + black points on the test plug (x1, 20), (2, 19), (6, 15), (8, 13). | 6.
Insert the test plug into the relay. | 7.
Connect the circuit as shown in the attached figure, using current wires rated for 10 A. | 8.
Set the angle measuring instrument selector to LEAD. | 9.
Connect the current injection leads to points (x5, 7) as shown in the figure for phase R. | 10.
Connect the voltage injection leads to points (x9, 10) as shown in the figure for phase R. | 11.
Inject voltage at 110 V. | 12.
Raise the current to 10 A. | 13.
Set the angle to the value given in the attached table. | 14.
Lower the voltage value gradually until relay 21G operates. | 15.
Record the voltage value at which the relay operates. | 16.
Reset on phase R. | 17.
Reset the lockout relay 86G. | 18.
Withdraw the test plug. | 19.
Clean the relay connection comb. | 20.
Insert the relay connection comb. | 21.
Replace the cover. | 22.
Repeat steps 11 to 13 on phase Y. | 23.
Repeat steps 11 to 13 on phase B. | 24.
Inside cell PRP1 T5:44, 46, connect the two terminals. | 25.
